verdicts.reason: A has a strong, readable headline and fills the portrait canvas well, but the alignment is mixed: GROVE is centred, the headline and body are flush left, and the pills and CTA are pushed right, so there is no common edge. The bottom cluster is also tight. B has weak hierarchy: the headline is small and sits above an odd large gap before the body, which leaves an orphaned 'bottles.' line. The FREE DELIVERY badge floats loose beside the pills, the shoe sits high in its circle, and about 140px of dead space is left at the bottom.
